siblings.summary: What to actually do across an Oslo weekend in late May 2026, with the Michelin dinner already booked.

sources.title: NDC Oslo
sources.claim: NDC Oslo 2026 runs Sept 14-18 at Oslo Spektrum with 165 sessions, 154 speakers, 14 workshops over 5 days.

sources.title: JavaZone 2026
sources.claim: JavaZone 2026 is the biggest community-driven Java conference in Norway.

sources.title: JavaZone 2026 (Monday Merch)
sources.claim: JavaZone 2026 runs Sept 2-3, 2026 at NOVA Spektrum Lillestrøm with 2,500+ visitors, 150+ exhibitors.

sources.title: NIC Conference
sources.claim: NIC 2026 runs Oct 13-15 at Oslo Spektrum with a 'less slides, more demos' format.

sources.title: Oslo Tech Show
sources.claim: Oslo Tech Show 2026 ran May 6-7 at Nova Spektrum, Lillestrøm — free admission, 100+ exhibitors.

sources.title: Booster Conference
sources.claim: Booster Conference 2026 ran March 11-13 in Bergen.

sources.title: Smidig Digitalisering 2026
sources.claim: Smidig Digitalisering 2026 ran May 27 at Oslo Kongressenter on AI in agile product teams.

sources.title: NDC AI
sources.claim: NDC AI 2026 runs June 8-10 at Rebel Oslo — a 3-day AI-only event with 18 speakers.

sources.title: EuroSTAR 2026
sources.claim: EuroSTAR 2026 runs June 15-18 at Nova Spektrum Oslo — Europe's largest software testing conference.

sources.title: React Norway / Rock & React
sources.claim: React Norway 2026 (Rock & React Festival) is a one-day event June 5 at Rockefeller Oslo.

sources.title: Y Oslo
sources.claim: Y Oslo 2026 runs Oct 26-27 at Chateau Neuf — Scandinavia's biggest UX conference.

sources.title: Oslo Innovation Week
sources.claim: Oslo Innovation Week 2026 runs Oct 19-23 — 80+ events across 50+ city-center venues, 16,000 attendees.

sources.title: Paranoia
sources.claim: Paranoia 2026 ran May 21-22 at Oslo Spektrum — the Nordics' leading cybersecurity conference.

sources.title: dev.events Oslo
sources.claim: Community calendar listing dev conferences in Oslo for 2026 including Data Saturday Oslo and MVP-Dagen.

sources.title: GDG Cloud Oslo
sources.claim: GDG Cloud Oslo runs roughly one event per month on GCP, AI, big data, IoT, ops.

sources.title: NNUG Oslo
sources.claim: NNUG Oslo (Norwegian .NET User Group) is Oslo's recurring .NET community meetup.

sources.title: Pils og Programmering Oslo
sources.claim: Pils og Programmering Oslo meets the last Friday of each month for open coding sessions.

sources.title: IxDA Oslo
sources.claim: IxDA Oslo is the city's biggest design community meetup — free talks.

sources.title: IQT Nordics
sources.claim: IQT Nordics 2026 runs June 22-24 at OsloMet — quantum-technology conference.

sources.title: Smidig (Smidig unConference)
sources.claim: Smidig unConference (Feb 24 at Rebel) — agile Open Space gathering.
